question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **concern.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"concern"** means a matter of interest or importance to someone; a feeling of worry or care about a specific issue. (चिंता, सरोकार)

 
 
• **Example: **Her main concern was the safety of her children during the trip.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that because environmental pollution seriously jeopardises both human health and ecosystems, it is an international issue.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"concern"** because it fits best in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interest** (रुचि): The feeling of wanting to know or learn about something.

 
 
• **Example:** His interest in gardening led him to create a beautiful backyard.
 
 
 
• **Duty** (कर्तव्य): A moral or legal obligation; a responsibility.
 
 
• **Example: **It is the duty of every citizen to vote in the elections.
 
 
 
• **Charge** (प्रभार): Responsibility for the care or control of something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She was in charge of organizing the annual company event.
